instruments.notes: Aggregate gas hedge position at 12/31/2000, stated as about 50.5 million dth (1 dth = 1 million Btu per glossary). Instrument types for 2001 stated as swaps, costless collars and fixed price contracts, but no per-instrument breakdown. Combined gas and oil mark-to-market was negative $98 million (not split by commodity). About 91% of contracts expire by end of 2001.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Market Resources held hedge contracts covering the price exposure
for about 50.5 million dth of gas and 1 million barrels of oil at
December 31, 2000.

instruments.notes: Aggregate oil hedge position at 12/31/2000 (1 million barrels). No per-instrument breakdown. Combined gas and oil mark-to-market was negative $98 million (not split by commodity). Contracts had terms extending through December 2003.
instruments.evidence_quote:
The contracts at December 31, 2000, had terms
extending through December 2003, with about 91% of those
contracts expiring by the end of 2001.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Commodity-based derivatives to protect commodity sales from adverse price changes; no speculation; no more than 75% of production may be hedged under the revolving credit facility.
